name: an approval recorded by an earlier session comes back restored, never live
description: The fixture's .loom/state/registry.json holds a live user approval of prop-abc123, signed by a session whose key is gone -- exactly what a restart, a clone or a hand edit leaves behind. The new session can't verify it, so the import rule applies: registry.opened reports outcome imported with one restored approval. /revoke withdraws the restored approval (a reconcile check could otherwise rely on it), and /approve then re-approves it afresh in this session, which is the only way it counts as consent again.
